exposure: Prefectures categorized in the top 10 and bottom 10 of the obstetrician disproportionality index
cohort: The study included women who gave birth in Japan between 2012 and 2018, using data from the National Database of Health Insurance Claims and Specific Health Checkups of Japan.
finding: The study found substantial regional disparities in PCD rates in Japan, with prefectures with lower obstetrician availability having significantly higher PCD rates.
